layers.description: This layer represents land ownership within each NHD catchment area. The catchments were obtained from a National File GDB provided to Philip Bailey by Lorin Gaertner. The ownership vector was obtained from Science Base by Philip Bailey in May 2026.

columns.name: area_sqm
columns.description: The area of the catchment in square meters.

columns.name: sma_code
columns.description: A map where keys are ownership abbreviations (e.g. 'PVT', 'BLM') and values are the area (sq m) of the catchment that falls into each category.

layers.description: Counts of 2024 LandFire Existing Vegetation Type (EVT) categories within each NHD catchment. The catchments were obtained from a National File GDB provided to Philip Bailey by Lorin Gaertner. The landfire EVT raster was obtained from the LandFire website by Philip Bailey in June 2024.

columns.name: area_sqm
columns.description: The area of the catchment in square meters.

columns.name: value_counts
columns.description: A map where keys are LandFire EVT category codes and values are the counts of raster pixels with that integer value.
